required_findings.criteria: Identifies that making the cell itself an accessibility element hides the Remove button from VoiceOver and Voice Control navigation, and recommends an accessibility custom action or keeping the button as a separate element.

Identifies that the UIButton(type: .system) title keeps a fixed font size and does not follow Dynamic Type, unlike the labels, and recommends UIButton.Configuration or a text-style title font with adjustment enabled.
Identifies that the verification code field lacks textContentType = .oneTimeCode, which prevents system code AutoFill and forces users to remember or transcribe the code.
Requires device verification of the Remove action with VoiceOver and Voice Control and of the button title at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes.

forbidden_claims: Claims the title or amount labels do not support Dynamic Type
Claims the accessibility identifier is announced as the field label
